newsitem.title: USA: Foster Wheeler March 28 backlog higher.
newsitem.headline: Foster Wheeler March 28 backlog higher.

text.p: Foster Wheeler Corp said Monday the backlog of unfilled orders as of March 28 totaled $7.1 billion compared with $6.5 billion at the end of the same month last year.
New orders booked for the first quarter of 1997 amounted to $1.2 billion compared with $1.4 billion for the first quarter of 1996, it added.

Foster Wheeler, an engineering firm, reported net earnings of $20.2 million or $0.50 a share on revenues of $978.5 million for the first quarter. A year ago, it had earnings of $23.4 million or $0.58 per share on revenues of $854.4 million.
